title: Go workspace with an explicit native compiler dependency
expected: Discover both workspace modules and their dependency once.
cgo requires a declared compiler and target ABI; cross-compiling is not assumed to work.

cases.name: cgo-disabled
cases.expect: Report unsupported build capability instead of substituting a different implementation.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
